decision: Keep exact SUM support kernel as an opt-in experiment. Substantial identical-search gains justify further native work; production defaults unchanged.
implementation: Exact equality support masks for SUM and LINEAR_SUM; intervals, dense-hole certificate, fixed/one/two active terms, reflected forward/backward DP.
C11 shared library called with ctypes and cached across invocations. One scratch workspace per numeric plan; no allocations in the C support computation.
Immutable integer contributions normalized in arbitrary-precision Python before C conversion. Large translations/coefficients are safe if the normalized spans fit.
C limits:3-64 columns in adapter,4096 candidates per column,total original span<=16384,plus original Python plan eligibility limits. One/two-column constraints remain Python.
Unsupported plans/calls retain Python support computation; domain retention, causes, checkpoints, rollback, search and policy remain Python.
Native support computation runs at all search depths when explicitly enabled, independently of the <=20-variable residual switch.
timing: Five paired shuffled repetitions per size/strategy in confirmation. Whole timing includes model/state construction, lazy C workspace preparation, mask encoding/decoding, propagation, residual work and fallback. Imports, library compilation/loading, validation and reduction auditing excluded. Audits are separate and not performance claims.
equivalence: Within each strategy, Python and C preserve nodes,failures,revisions,termination,solutions,residual counters and all audited ordered reduction hashes. C support outputs compared to Python on every audited call.
safety: 14 SUM tests plus23 residual tests pass: exhaustive support oracles with signed,holey,large-translation data; max spans/word edges; certificates and DP; fixpoint cache; fallback; causes and rollback.
ASan/UBSan standalone randomized exhaustive oracle passes10006 checks including large candidate masks and maximum span.
Repository-wide ruff,mypy src,Markdown link checks and git diff --check passed.

limitations: Opt-in source-checkout experiment; no production module/default/wheel change. Current solve benchmarking covers pure feasibility.
